_comment: Generated by Tools/terrain/dressing.mjs from the heightmap + layout. Instances are flat [x, y, z, yaw, scale, ...] in cm/degrees; hazards are flat [x, y, z, ...] cell centres (lava's fine flow in hazards.lavaGrid); caves carry their mesh variant and size. Read at runtime by UWRDressingSubsystem.

lavaGrid._comment: The lava flow: rows of grid points [row j, first column i, count n, then n pairs (ground cm, cover dm)]; a point is world (i * spacing - half, j * spacing - half). Lava surface = ground + lift(cover), lift = sink..top over cover coverLow..coverHigh (smoothstep, cover in m); lava is where lift > 0.
